title: Config Space Schema
description: Defines the configuration exploration space for a tunable. Includes TVAR definitions, constraints, objectives, exploration strategy, and promotion policy. This is the canonical TVL 0.9 config space definition.

id.x-content-note: INV-GAP S1,S3,S5,O2,H1: not inventoried (free string): id
id.description: Unique identifier for this config space

schema_version.x-content-note: INV-GAP: was closed_enum; contract has no enum/const, so the value is not provably content-free

tunable_id.x-content-note: INV-GAP S1,S3,S5,O2,H1: not inventoried (free string): tunable_id
tunable_id.description: Reference to the tunable this config space belongs to

constraints.description: Structural and behavioral constraints (legacy textual or typed TVL 0.9)

exploration.description: Exploration strategy, budgets, and convergence settings

promotion_policy.description: Promotion policy for selecting optimal configurations

defaults.x-content-note: INV-GAP S1,S3,S5,O2,H1: not inventoried (free object/array): defaults

measures.description: List of metric names produced by the service for this config space

created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when this config space was created

updated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the last modification to this config space

metadata.description: Additional metadata about the config space
